songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Open the house, let it breathe
[Verse 1]
She lifts the latch in every room
The winter cloth comes off the chair
A cup waits cool beside the window
The room smells faintly of cedar
And clean sheets from the line
Dust turns slowly in the air
At the doorway, she remembers
Two hands learning how to stay
[Chorus]
Warm afternoon across the sill
Are You Near?
The whole house loosens at the corners
As if your step has crossed the stair
[Verse 2]
She folds the blanket, shakes the pillow
Sets one letter in the sun
A blue cup waits beside the saucer
Clouds keep passing through the maple
Spring begins with everyone
Yet one small hush beside the porch
Keeps turning back her ear
[Chorus]
Open rooms and lifted curtains
Are You Near?
Long winter leaves without a quarrel
Relief comes in on tender air
[Final Chorus]
Are You Near?
The window answers, then is silent
Shall I leave the doorway wide?
Are You Near?
